parsed.name: 中央控制器（CC）
parsed.description: 用于量子实验（尤其是超导量子比特）的硬件序列与定时控制器核心模块。它负责加载并执行序列程序，通过数字后背板与 CCIO 模块和 VSM 等外设交互，提供DIO链路校准、边沿延时校准、触发与运行控制，以及状态/事件监控与报告。
parsed.description_en: Core hardware sequencer and timing controller for quantum experiments (notably superconducting qubits). It loads and executes sequence programs, interfaces via digital backplane with CCIO modules and VSM, performs DIO link calibration, edge-delay tuning, trigger/run control, and comprehensive status/event monitoring.
